title: Input Trust and Prompt Injection
outOfScope: Release publication and external provider mutation (WI-16)
rawUserRequest: 继续执行全面整改计划的 WI-05：建立 human/repository/issue/web/log/dependency/tool/generated 输入的 sourceType、trustLevel、instructionAuthority、mayContainInstructions、external 模型，分离内容与授权，并完成完整 PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和文档对齐流程。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

sources.reason: Existing prompt guidance and enforcement limitation.

riskAssessment.reason: Bounded local classifier and corpus only; no external authorization or production mutation is performed.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution of the remediation plan; this Work Item is bounded to local classification and negative tests.

preReviewWarnings: Classifier results are detection/containment signals, not proof of cryptographic authenticity or complete semantic detection.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Human, repository, issue, web, log, dependency, tool, and generated inputs are represented with sourceType, trustLevel, instructionAuthority, mayContainInstructions, and external metadata.

Content is separated from authorization: repository/issue/web/log/dependency/tool/generated instructions cannot grant approval, override, secret access, push, merge, release, deletion, or permission changes.

Direct, indirect, bilingual/mixed-language, Markdown/HTML hidden, Base64, Unicode, nested-reference, malicious-filename, and CI-annotation corpus cases produce detected/contained/blocked/human_confirmation_required/not_detected/out_of_scope outcomes without privilege elevation.
High-risk operation evaluation requires an explicit re-evaluation result and fail-closed handling for forged approval, override, secret, emergency, or administrator claims.
Focused corpus tests, full AI/project checks, and security-boundary documentation pass before PR creation; no external mutation is performed.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The repository currently treats prompt guidance and hard gates as separate concepts but has no typed, testable boundary for untrusted instructions embedded in repository, issue, web, log, dependency, tool, or generated content.
constraints: Keep content separate from execution authority.
Fail closed for high-risk actions and forged approvals.
Do not claim complete prompt-injection detection or external identity assurance.
Keep the implementation local and deterministic; no network or provider mutation.
intent.rationale: A structured input trust record and negative corpus make the authority boundary explicit and reviewable while preserving the existing hard-gate model.

declaredIntent.summary: Classify untrusted input and prevent embedded instructions from becoming execution authority.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A message claiming administrator approval cannot authorize a high-risk operation.
Hidden Markdown/HTML/Base64/Unicode instructions are detected or contained without privilege elevation.
Mixed-language nested references and tool/log output remain untrusted content.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
